spec.hypothesis: Integer C maximizes abs(EMAfast_END-EMAslow_END). Both filters use close; Nfast=72*C/(divisor*dt),Nslow=89*C/(divisor*dt).
spec.admissibility: Nfast>=1,Nslow>=1. No global source_seconds floor in long branch.

seed_policies.START_OHLC: Both EMA states initialized at bar0 OHLC seed; process close bars1..END.
seed_policies.bootstrap20_extrema: At bar19 initialize both states with minlow/maxhigh of first20bars; process closes20..END. Motivated by empirical short/long boundary, not verified original initialization.

spec.tie_policy: Smallest C whose score is within1e-12 of maximum in normalized price units.
spec.selection: No fitted coefficients, no per-case seed choice, no clock/absoluteprice conditions. Thirty fixed candidates, must fit all9 local matrix before any training32 scoring.
spec.scope: Different from prior endpoint-contact/cross roots: objective is maximum final separation, not a zero-crossing. Tests this finite family only; no general EMA optimization rejection.
